capabilities.name: ipv6_underlay
capabilities.probe_evidence: bind a v6 socket and obtain a routable source address
capabilities.absent_consequence: No v6 candidates gathered; higher relay incidence

capabilities.name: dplpmtud
capabilities.probe_evidence: emit a padded authenticated probe on the tunnel socket
capabilities.absent_consequence: MTU stays clamped at the 1280 B floor; throughput cost only

capabilities.name: portmap
capabilities.probe_evidence: issue a real PCP/NAT-PMP request to the default gateway
capabilities.absent_consequence: Fewer server-reflexive candidates

capabilities.name: site_remap
capabilities.probe_evidence: policy-routing table writable and per-prefix translation programmable
capabilities.absent_consequence: Overlapping LAN prefixes cannot be disambiguated; the route is REFUSED, not mis-delivered

capabilities.name: per_app_routing
capabilities.probe_evidence: per-app VPN binding API present AND entitlement granted
capabilities.absent_consequence: Split-by-app policy unenforceable; policy fails closed

capabilities.name: path_migration
capabilities.probe_evidence: tunnel engine supports endpoint rebinding in this build
capabilities.absent_consequence: Roaming drops the Session (R-07 lost)

capabilities.name: multipath_probe
capabilities.probe_evidence: concurrent probe sockets available
capabilities.absent_consequence: Direct-path upgrade while RELAYED is slower (R-12)

capabilities.name: relay_udp
capabilities.probe_evidence: relay handshake completes over UDP

capabilities.name: relay_quic
capabilities.probe_evidence: relay handshake completes over QUIC
capabilities.absent_consequence: Loses the UDP:443 rung

capabilities.name: relay_tls
capabilities.probe_evidence: relay handshake completes over TCP/TLS
capabilities.absent_consequence: UDP-blocked networks lose the last rung (R-18)

capabilities.name: relay_standby
capabilities.probe_evidence: a second relay flow can be held warm
capabilities.absent_consequence: Failover is cold; the R-10 bound is not met

capabilities.name: relay_multiplex
capabilities.probe_evidence: multiple peer flows on one relay binding
capabilities.absent_consequence: One relay flow per peer pair

capabilities.name: exit_node
capabilities.probe_evidence: forwarding AND source translation programmable, per family
capabilities.absent_consequence: The family is not offered - never silently forwarded untranslated

capabilities.name: lan_gateway
capabilities.probe_evidence: forwarding + per-peer policy hooks installable
capabilities.absent_consequence: Subnet routes are not accepted (R-17 diagnostics apply)

capabilities.name: gateway_multiclient
capabilities.probe_evidence: per-peer state and accounting available
capabilities.absent_consequence: The I7 gateway role is unavailable

capabilities.name: dns_split
capabilities.probe_evidence: per-domain resolver API present (NRPT / resolved / NE)
capabilities.absent_consequence: Split DNS unavailable; policy picks full or off - never system-resolver fallback (R-14)

capabilities.name: dns_full
capabilities.probe_evidence: global resolver override installable
capabilities.absent_consequence: Full-tunnel DNS unavailable

capabilities.name: kill_switch_os
capabilities.probe_evidence: install-then-remove a DUAL-FAMILY probe rule in the OS filter engine; both families or neither
capabilities.absent_consequence: I3 unenforceable; the device MUST NOT claim protection it cannot deliver

capabilities.name: kill_switch_boot
capabilities.probe_evidence: verify the boot-time rule set is present before the agent starts
capabilities.absent_consequence: The boot window is unprotected; disclosed per platform, observable fleet-wide

capabilities.name: dns_scoped_api
capabilities.probe_evidence: probe the platform split-DNS API (NRPT / matchDomains / per-link resolved)
capabilities.absent_consequence: Steering degrades to containment-only; DNS.PLATFORM.* diagnostic

capabilities.name: dns_dnssec_validate
capabilities.probe_evidence: validate a known-good and a known-bad zone
capabilities.absent_consequence: Validation not performed; stated, not silent

capabilities.name: dns_upstream_dot
capabilities.probe_evidence: open a DoT connection to the configured upstream
capabilities.absent_consequence: Upstream is Do53 inside the overlay

capabilities.name: dns_config_dies_with_tunnel
capabilities.probe_evidence: platform property: resolver configuration is scoped to the interface lifetime
capabilities.absent_consequence: Requires HostResolverRestorePoint (S-34) and a boot restore unit

capabilities.name: relay_map_gossip
capabilities.probe_evidence: accept a peer-carried signed relay map
capabilities.absent_consequence: Relay map refresh requires the control plane

capabilities.name: kernel_datapath
capabilities.probe_evidence: open the kernel WireGuard / WinTun-class device
capabilities.absent_consequence: Userspace throughput budget applies (R-15)

capabilities.name: rekey_in_place
capabilities.probe_evidence: in-process
capabilities.absent_consequence: Listed so its absence is nameable; mandatory at every Phase 1 epoch

capabilities.name: psk_epoch
capabilities.probe_evidence: in-process
capabilities.absent_consequence: The R-13 revocation lever is unavailable => refuse

capabilities.name: diag_bundle
capabilities.probe_evidence: in-process
capabilities.absent_consequence: No R-23 connectivity report obtainable from that peer
